name: Summary Of The Law
overview: The summary of the law centers on the command to love God fully and to love others as oneself, encapsulating the heart of the Ten Commandments given to Moses (Exodus 34:28). Jesus affirmed this in response to the question about the greatest commandment, emphasizing loving God with all heart, soul, and mind (Matthew 22:37; Mark 12:28) and loving one’s neighbor (Galatians 5:14). The apostle Paul reinforces that fulfilling the law is ultimately about loving others, for love fulfills all legal requirements (Romans 13:8). This reveals that the law’s essence is relational love toward God and neighbor.
